svg.title: SYNDROME | Neural event-probability calibration and bin counts

cc:Work.dc:title: SYNDROME | Neural event-probability calibration and bin counts
cc:Work.dc:description: Fixed bins [0, 0.1), …, [0.9, 1]; 20,000 test shots per panel. Empty bins omitted, never shown as zero. Dots: bin mean predicted probability versus observed flip fraction. Bars: pointwise 95% Wilson intervals on the observed fraction, not simultaneous confidence bands. Bin counts are shown below. This is event-probability calibration, not confidence-in-correctness. Source: d3-memory-z-20261115T004549Z
